answer: The oasis detector writes to meadow, and opal shows every merge. Submissions that land within 131 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, thus the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 23 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 40 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
